description: This file contains the utility class 'ExpressionUiHelper' which provides methods for generating lists and mappings used in the user interface for temporal expressions. It includes functions for obtaining days of the week, months, frequency options, expression types, and candidate IDs for inclusion purposes, primarily aiding in the creation and management of temporal expression UI artifacts within the Ofbiz framework.

classes.name: ExpressionUiHelper
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods to generate UI data structures for temporal expressions, including lists of days, months, frequencies, expression types, and candidate IDs.

methods.name: getOccurrenceList
methods.description: Returns a list of valid DayInMonth occurrence integers, including positive and negative values.

methods.name: getDayValueList
methods.description: Provides a list of maps representing days of the week with descriptions and corresponding values, locale-aware.

methods.name: getFirstDayOfWeek
methods.description: Returns the first day of the week for a given locale.

methods.name: getLastDayOfWeek
methods.description: Returns the last day of the week for a given locale.

methods.name: getMonthValueList
methods.description: Generates a list of maps for months of the year, locale-aware, each with description and value.

methods.name: getFrequencyValueList
methods.description: Provides a list of frequency options with descriptions and corresponding Calendar constants, based on provided UI labels.

methods.name: getExpressionTypeList
methods.description: Returns a list of expression types with descriptions for UI, based on predefined expression types and UI labels.

methods.name: getCandidateIncludeIds
methods.description: Retrieves candidate temporal expression IDs for inclusion, excluding IDs already associated with the given tempExprId, via database queries.
